children: ARC Group Acquisition I entered into a Share Purchase Agreement to combine with Firstborn Top Capital, valuing the transaction at $1.0 billion subject to customary adjustments. All Firstborn shares will be exchanged for ARC Group Acquisition I Class A shares at the redemption price, and the company will be renamed BlueCrest Investment after closing. The deal has no minimum cash condition, and the combined company's shares and warrants are expected to trade on Nasdaq, subject to approvals and other closing conditions.
